card.name: Letters NP/PN inside acronyms
card.fires_on: Short capital letter pieces like PN or NP inside medical acronyms, such as parenteral nutrition (PN) and BNP, and the NO in a drug name. Also the piece ann before ul in annul.

modes.label: PN as parenteral nutrition
modes.description: The letters PN stand for parenteral nutrition, in container, solution or infusion wording.
modes.example: inspect the<< PN>> solution to ensure precipitates or cloudiness

modes.label: NP in BNP
modes.description: The NP ending of the B-type natriuretic peptide abbreviation BNP.
modes.example: 5.2 Elevation of B-Type Natriuretic Peptide Treatment with SKYCLARYS can cause an increase in B<<NP>>, a marker of cardiac function.

modes.label: Other split pieces
modes.description: A short piece inside a brand name or rare word.

card.plain: It fires on the letters PN and NP in abbreviations like parenteral nutrition and BNP.
